title: StrictEvaluatedPositions
description: The positions --strict-properties reaches an object schema through without the static reading producing a struct for it. Each of viaThen, viaElse, viaDependent and viaNotNot is a sub-schema the generator compiles to schema data and interprets at validation time, and that lowering carried no ban at all -- so the flag's own sentence, 'absent additionalProperties is treated as false', held where an object compiled to a struct and not where it compiled to a node (issue #221). `pooled` is the control that a ban synthesised per allOf branch would break: additionalProperties reads the properties of the schema object it sits in, and the static path pools an allOf branch's into the merged struct before the ban goes on, so {"a":1,"b":2} conforms and {"a":1,"b":2,"x":3} does not. A ban written once per branch would refuse both, and no document would satisfy the composition.
